response.description:
Azure
Data Box now automatically generates a downloadable Secure Erasure
Certificate for every completed order, providing verification that all data on
the device has been securely erased in accordance with NIST
800-88 Revision 2 standards.   The certificate is created as part
of the standard cleanup process and is accessible directly from the Azure
portal. This enhancement reduces audit complexity and eliminates the need for
manual validation, while increasing transparency and simplifying compliance for
organizations handling sensitive data, such as: government, law enforcement,
and financial services.  Learn more: Azure
Data Box security and data protection Migrating
your on-premises data to Azure
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Data Box enhances compliance with automatic Secure Erasure Certificates
